title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 592  An Act Converting the Naruangan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Tuao, Province of Cagayan, Into a National High School to Be Known as Tuao Vocational and Technical School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds

title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Naruangan Barangay tại Thị trấn Tuao, Tỉnh Cagayan thành Trường Trung học Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Kỹ thuật Tuao Vocational
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Naruangan Barangay ในเทศบาล Tuao จังหวัด Cagayan เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนเทคนิค Tuao Vocational
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Naruangan Barangay di Kotamadya Tuao, Provinsi Cagayan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Teknik Tuao Vocational

text.en:
The Naruangan Barangay High School in the Municipality of Tuao, Province of Cagayan, is
hereby converted into a national high school to be known as Tuao Vocational and Technical School.

The operation of said school for the current fiscal year shall continue to be funded out of local
funds and from its share of national aid to local schools. The requirements for succeeding fiscal years shall be
provided in the forthcoming General Appropriations Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 24, 1983
